event.name: c. 3300–2600 BC: Early Harappan cultures in the Indus region

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The Wikipedia century page lists the Early Harappan period as c.3300–2600 BCE; the linked civilization article explains multiple chronology schemes and the separate mature urban phase. This entry is a broad regional period note, not a single event, a claimed political state, an exact boundary date, or proof that every site was occupied in every year. The existing c.3000 Harappa Ravi-phase note describes the specific site and remains separate. The point and radius are game references, not archaeological boundaries. NewsIndex can surface a long-duration note in each indexed year; it should be interpreted as context, not new news each year.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: Approximate centuries-long archaeological period. Encoded -3300..-2599 exclusive to include the year called 2600 BCE; boundaries are not exact.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Reference point and gameplay radius for parts of the Indus region, not the full extent or a mapped boundary.
